instruction: Find the personal homepages of the paper's second and third authors and save them in a 'Liked Authors' folder within the Chrome Bookmarks bar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires: 1) Opening PDF and identifying 2nd author (Guanzhi Wang) and 3rd author (Yunfan Jiang), 2) Searching for their personal webpages, 3) Creating bookmark folder 'Liked Authors', 4) Bookmarking the found URLs. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric. The evaluator checks if the specified URLs are bookmarked under 'Liked Authors' folder. Verified author names from PDF page 1.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct URLs are bookmarked in correct folder, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: folder name 'Liked Authors' matches instruction exactly (instruction line 4, metric chrome.py:160)
Getter get_bookmarks() correctly extracts Chrome bookmark state from Bookmarks file
Metric is_expected_bookmarks() with type 'liked_authors_websites_urls' correctly checks: (1) folder 'Liked Authors' exists under bookmark_bar, (2) URLs match expected author websites
Expected URLs are correct for 2nd author (Guanzhi Wang) and 3rd author (Yunfan Jiang) with multiple valid URL options per author
Logic correctly uses product(*urls) to handle multiple URL alternatives per author (chrome.py:174-178)
Evaluator verifies the end state (correct bookmarks in correct folder) which is the proper verification approach for this task
